name: fusion
description: Nested multi-agent coding swarm + multi-model council for Codex. Architect (Fable 5.1 / Astra gpt-6-astra) designs a custom hive; captains are any live CLI; nested workers are real AndrewCode processes on one Hive Board (WAL sqlite + JSONL, no daemon). Codex conducts local CLI panelists through Fusion's bash adapters and stdlib Python swarm backend (panel, council, debate, vote, swarm, MoA, heavy, graph, ladder, breaker, ballot, MetaLoop, hive).

interface.shortDescription: Conduct nested AndrewCode hives and local model councils from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Fusion bundles Codex skills, bash adapters, provider detection, a learning ledger, and a stdlib Python swarm engine for panel, council, debate, vote, swarm, MoA, heavy, graph, ladder, breaker, ballot, verification-gate, MetaLoop, and Hive workflows. Hive adds an architect (Fable 5.1 / Astra gpt-6-astra) that may design a custom nested swarm, captains from any live CLI, nested AndrewCode worker processes, and one Hive Board (WAL sqlite + JSONL sidecar, no daemon). MetaLoop remains the asymmetric Board Advisor (Fable) + GPT Chief Operator + expert/fast labor tiers.
